about: the analog stick on the keyboard (2026-11-20, controls): F2 > CONTROLS > KEYBOARD (P1): BUTTONS & STICK opened in the QA Royal Rumble (qa_op 23), the cursor on its first row, ANALOG STICK. The script, every 8 s: ENTER (the row's capture: its four keys in turn), then T, G, F, H -- the stick's up, down, left, right ('[pads] keyboard: STICK_UP = T' ..., saved in controls_n64.json). Scripted keys: the exe's vpad script 'key' lines (SDL's key state). Read the log and the copy's controls_n64.json after the run.

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: a capture ended with a key set and saved
